edit.description: guard the plan-state and questions-index spans; absence takes the placeholder, a failed read refuses
refusal cases over the wrong kind in place; cold-root and no-headings pins

summary: the package's plan-slice prompts answer an unreadable plan-state or questions artifact with the same placeholder they answer an absent one with
acceptance: A plan slice whose plan-state or questions artifact exists but cannot be read renders no placeholder — the tick refuses as render-refused
tests: every plan slice prompt refuses when its plan state artifact is a directory in place
every plan slice prompt refuses when its open-questions artifact is a directory in place
pins: a cold state root renders every plan slice prompt's placeholder as its block's whole content
a questions file carrying no headings renders the plan slices' none-open placeholder
notes: Sites: plan-derive.md:12,16; plan-sweep.md:8,16; plan-inbox.md:16. Reproduced: `cat P 2>/dev/null || echo` and `grep -n '^## ' P || echo` both exit 0 with the placeholder over a directory in place. The idiom shipped at c26e8fd (examples/prompts/plan.md:4) transfers for `cat`. `grep` needs its exit 1 (file read, no headings) kept legitimate and its exit 2 loud — hence the second pin. harness/planState.ts readPlanState already draws exactly this line ENOENT-vs-throw.

every artifact in the example prompt odd-root table is read by at least one shipped template
notes: Sites: tests/harnessPrompts.test.ts:294-309 (`if (!spanSubstitutes(...)) continue`, then `asserted > 0`); tests/examples.test.ts:452-469 (`if (reads.length === 0) continue`). The stronger pin already sits in the same file at examples.test.ts:656,691 and was not shared with its siblings (`engineering.md`, *The fix lands at the mechanism*). Equality with table length is wrong here — an artifact several prompts read counts several times; the property is per-artifact coverage.
